title: Approve: Commit the new sub-account
reason: 'Confirm' cannot be undone, so a person must decide
instructions: Click 'Take this ticket', so nobody else handles it at the same time.
Check that the screen shows what was asked: member number ***56, share type REGULAR SAVINGS, initial deposit ***00.
If it does, click 'Approve'. The automation then clicks 'Confirm'. This can't be undone.
If anything looks wrong, click 'Don't do it'. Nothing is submitted.
